description: Four genuine wristband barcodes were cloned and resold: they appear 15, 12, 9 and 7 times, 39 extra entries in all, each copy carrying the same sale record but a different gate and time. ticket_id should be unique, yet nunique() falls short of the row count and value_counts() puts the clones on top. An identifier that isn't unique is an old trap: the Woolworth wallet sample card of 1938 carried a real Social Security number, 078-05-1120, that thousands of people went on to use as their own. The festival and its data are fictional.
hints: Some columns should contain every value only once. Check whether they do.
Compare the number of unique barcodes with the number of rows.
ticket_id is not unique: four barcodes were scanned 15, 12, 9 and 7 times. They are clones.
